prompts.title: Tasks and prompts
prompts.help: The global prompt applies to all AI tasks. Task prompts guide wording, search preferences, and evidence selection. Peach controls the output format and confirms changes before saving them.

defaults.system:
You are the assistant for a private library in Peach. Prepare search filters, translation drafts, tag candidates, and catalog changes for review.

• Use an explicit work code to identify a release. One work can have a source title, a library display title, translated text, and multiple files or editions. Similar titles alone do not identify duplicates.
• Keep library records, external catalogs, publisher material, and visible footage distinct. Base observations on the evidence supplied for the current task and stay within what that evidence establishes.
• Leave missing, conflicting, or unclear details blank. Return only the candidate or plan the task asks for. Peach handles review, saving, renaming, and deletion.
defaults.search:
Turn the request into filters or work tasks that Peach can run.

• For the library, use an exact work code when given. Otherwise choose a short, distinctive term. Put explicitly named performers, studios, and canonical tags in the matching fields.
• Distinguish date added from release date, unwatched from Watch Later, and flagged from rated. For “recently added and unwatched,” sort by date added and select the unwatched state. “Find works missing English” uses a missing-translation filter. “Translate this work into English” starts a translation task.
• For external discovery, use a short work code, Japanese title, or name. Watch state, date added, and personal marks are library-only. For both scopes, provide conditions suitable for each.
• On a follow-up, change the fields the user mentions and retain applicable context. Treat a standalone request as new. If a required condition cannot be represented, preserve the response schema and leave the filter fields empty. Avoid broadening the scope or guessing titles.
defaults.translate:
Translate the supplied title and synopsis separately into the requested language. Make the title readable in a work list and preserve the synopsis's narrative detail.

• Preserve work codes, series names, studios, performer names, and edition details. Prefer the source spelling for a name without a reliable localized form, and use a consistent spelling throughout.
• Preserve tone, negation, qualifiers, quantities, and relationships while writing naturally in the target language. Keep claims in the same terms as the source.
• Translate only supplied content. Keep an empty field empty and avoid filling it from the other field. Omit translator notes from the result.
defaults.tags:
Suggest reviewable Peach catalog tags from the title, synopsis, and unmapped source genres.

• Use the exact canonical labels supplied. Prefer specific, distinct labels that help someone filter the library. Skip synonyms, overly broad labels, and excluded terms.
• Give a short verbatim excerpt for each candidate. The excerpt must directly support the tag. Two words appearing together do not establish a relationship.
• Evaluate roles, clothing, settings, and themes separately. Negation, rhetorical language, and marketing copy do not establish what actually appears in footage. Return fewer candidates or none when evidence is weak.
defaults.vision:
Analyze the one cover image or video frame provided. Support Peach's canonical visual labels with clear details in that image.

• Check cropping and occlusion first. Assess camera angle, posture, clothing, and setting separately. An overhead camera, a person leaning forward, and a first-person viewpoint are distinct observations.
• Treat cover lettering, badges, decoration, and collage panels as layout elements. Inspect each collage panel on its own. Avoid joining people from different panels into one scene.
• State the concrete feature you can see. Leave identity, age, consent, plot, and any sequence of actions that a single image cannot establish unspecified.
defaults.timeline:
Review the numbered previews Peach sampled across different times and scenes. Your observations cover only the frames provided.

• Within each group, compare visible orientation, points of support, relative position, and camera angle. Distinguish a cut or camera move from a posture change. Skip duplicate and black frames.
• One clear frame can establish a visible static feature. For pose relationships, interactions, or changes, cite corroborating frames that are close in time and in the same supplied group.
• Put supplied frame numbers that warrant a closer look in needs_context. Cite only frame numbers you were given. Keep posture and camera observations distinct from the evidence for a tag.
defaults.official:
Treat publisher stills as individual promotional images and reference the photo numbers Peach supplies.

• Focus on clear clothing, accessories, posture, camera angle, and setting. Publisher material can include staged photos, cropped images, and collages.
• Cite the exact photo number for each observation. Repeated static details can corroborate a label. Photo order does not establish timing or a sequence from the source video.
• Omit interaction, duration, or plot claims without continuous evidence. Treat text overlaid on the image as design rather than visual evidence of a scene.
defaults.metadata:
Turn explicitly requested edits into a Peach metadata draft. Supported draft fields are the library title, original title, studio, and release date.

• Use the supplied work code to identify the work. Leave the target for the user to pick if it is ambiguous. Keep display titles, source titles, and translations distinct. Use the field and replacement text the user specified.
• Preserve spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and language. Format a complete release date as YYYY-MM-DD and leave incomplete or uncertain dates blank.
• Finding missing metadata is a search or cleanup request. Leave fields without an explicit replacement blank for review.
defaults.organize:
Identify cleanup requests for the Peach review tools, such as possible duplicates, alternate cuts, and missing metadata.

• A shared work code, similar title, or similar filename is a clue. A single release can have a full version, split parts, copies at different resolutions, and alternate editions.
• Route an inventory request to review. Leave duplicate status and retention choices undecided without a direct file comparison.
• Select the library organization task for cleanup requests. Peach's corresponding tools handle confirmation before moving or deleting files or changing metadata.

preferencesPanel.localAppearanceHelp: Theme, accent color and glow apply only to this browser. Turn this off to restore the instance appearance.
preferencesPanel.instanceSaveFailed: Could not save preferences to this instance ({{error}})

pushDiscovery.cloudPrefixesHelp: Cloud notifications and cloud downloads both use this table to map cloud paths to media folders.
pushDiscovery.invalidPasteHelp: If the Windows desktop app shows “Invalid” after you paste, save this as a .toml file in the %LOCALAPPDATA%\CloudDrive.WinUI\webhooks\ directory.
pushDiscovery.needsLanUrl: Requires a LAN URL that CloudDrive2 can reach.
pushDiscovery.noSecret: No shared secret yet. It's generated when you save settings.
pushDiscovery.webhookHelp: Paste into CloudDrive2 under Settings → Webhooks (membership required). Paste again after you rotate the secret.

releaseUpdates.connectionLost: Can't reach Peach. Make sure it is running, then refresh the page.
releaseUpdates.dockerUpdateBody: Watchtower pulls the Peach {{version}} image and recreates the container. The /data volume is kept, and running tasks resume after startup.
releaseUpdates.installAfterRestart: Peach {{version}} will be installed after a restart.
releaseUpdates.installerHelp: Open the disk image and drag Peach to Applications to replace the old version. Your data and settings are kept. If macOS says the app is damaged, see the release page.
releaseUpdates.latestTestBuild: You have the latest test build.
releaseUpdates.updatePackageHelp: The app update reuses installed tools. Missing, damaged, or outdated tools are downloaded separately.
releaseUpdates.watchtowerHint: Start Watchtower with the compose watchtower profile to update from here in one click. Read the Docker deployment guide first.

remoteAccess.hostnameHelp: The Cloudflare Zero Trust hostname that points to the computer running Peach.
remoteAccess.namedHelp: Uses the fixed domain you set up in Cloudflare. Set an access password first.
remoteAccess.quickHelp: Temporary URL that changes on restart. Set an access password first.
remoteAccess.title: Cloudflare remote access

repairCenter.applyBody_one: {{count, number}} item will be changed. The database is backed up first, so you can restore it from database backups.
repairCenter.applyBody_other: {{count, number}} items will be changed. The database is backed up first, so you can restore it from database backups.
repairCenter.deleteBody: This deletes {{amount}} and can't be undone. The 3 most recent snapshots of each followed source and any snapshots still referenced by items are kept.
repairCenter.failedNote_one: {{count, number}} video failed; retry it in {{place}}
repairCenter.failedNote_other: {{count, number}} videos failed; retry them in {{place}}
repairCenter.startAllTitle: Start all repairs that need confirmation
repairCenter.startGroupTitle: Start repairs in “{{group}}” that need confirmation
repairCenter.startManyBody: They start one after another. Items that change the database back it up first, so you can restore it from database backups.
repairCenter.startManyBodyDelete: They start one after another. Items that change the database back it up first, so you can restore it from database backups. Deleted snapshots can't be restored.

retention.backupsHelp: Keeps this many recent pre-write backups; anything from the last 24 hours stays.
retention.logsHelp: Logs not written to for this long are deleted.
retention.title: Retention

sfwShortcut.recordHint: Press a new key combination, or Esc to cancel
sfwShortcut.title: SFW shortcut

sidebarGlow.nativeGlassNote: This preset uses each glass pane's own reflections, so its colors follow the light or dark theme.

signedInDevices.passwordChangeNotice: Changing the access password signs out all devices.
signedInDevices.title: Signed-in devices

smbShare.help: Enter the address as smb://server/share/directory. Peach reads and writes with the share account's permissions, and stores metadata and previews in the Peach data directory.
smbShare.keepPassword: Leave blank to keep the saved password

startup.launchAtStartupHelp: Starts Peach automatically after you sign in to this computer.
startup.title: Startup
startup.trayOnly: Start only the tray, without opening the web app
startup.trayOnlyHelp: Runs in the background at startup. Open the web app from the tray when needed.

storageLimits.autoCleanHelp: Cleans up playback caches and thumbnails, oldest first
storageLimits.cacheDetected: Detected automatically. Save settings to apply.
storageLimits.cacheLimitHelp: Playback, online media, and thumbnail caches
storageLimits.cloudDriveMissing: CloudDrive isn't configured. Enter the cache directory manually.
storageLimits.dataLimitHelp: Fetching and repairs pause at the limit; playback is unaffected
storageLimits.enableHelp: Over a limit, old caches are cleaned up first, then background tasks pause. Playback is affected only when the disk runs out of space.
storageLimits.externalCacheHelp: Detected from CloudDrive on the computer running Peach, or enter it manually. Never cleaned up automatically.
storageLimits.externalCacheLimitHelp: Repairs pause at the limit. Leave empty to check free disk space only.
storageLimits.limitsHelp: Leave a limit empty for no limit. Tasks already running may exceed it.
storageLimits.pausedWithReasons: {{reasons}}. Adjust the limits or clean up, then retry repairs in Tasks.
storageLimits.reservedSpaceHelp: Leave empty to reserve 5% automatically (min 1 GiB, max 40 GiB)
storageLimits.title: Storage limits

storageSpace.measureProgress: Measuring progress (estimated from the last count)
storageSpace.measuringOfLast_one: Counted {{files}} file · {{size}}, progress estimated from {{expected, number}} last time
storageSpace.measuringOfLast_other: Counted {{files}} files · {{size}}, progress estimated from {{expected, number}} last time
storageSpace.moveConfirm: Moves {{size}} of data from {{from}} to {{to}}. Peach quits during the move and reopens when it's done. The original data is deleted once it's verified at the new location.
storageSpace.selectedSummary_one: {{count, number}} category selected, {{size}} can be freed
storageSpace.selectedSummary_other: {{count, number}} categories selected, {{size}} can be freed

taskSpeed.defaultSpeedHelp: New tasks use this speed. You can adjust running tasks individually on the Tasks page.
taskSpeed.title: Background tasks

tour.reopenDescription: Brings back the tour button in the top-right corner on all devices. Your progress is kept.

transcoding.modeHelp: Used to transcode videos during playback.
transcoding.qualityHelp: Applies only to videos that need re-encoding; lower it on slow networks.
transcoding.title: Playback

uninstall.confirmAppOnly: Quits Peach and removes the app. Settings, local database, watch history, and cache are kept.
uninstall.confirmFull: Quits Peach and removes the app with its settings, local database, watch history, credentials, and cache. Your media files are kept.
uninstall.fullHelp: Also delete settings, the local database, watch history, credentials, and caches
uninstall.help: Uninstalling removes only the Peach app. Original media files are kept.
uninstall.title: Uninstall Peach

upgradeRepairs.deferredHelp: The rest waits for the mount to come back or the source to reopen, and continues automatically.
upgradeRepairs.capacityReady: The last storage check passed. Select Retry failed to check storage again and resume repairs.
upgradeRepairs.runningHelp: Filling in metadata and previews in the background.
upgradeRepairs.title: Auto-repair

userscriptStatus.addingDisabledHelp: Turn on Add from browser to add videos to Peach directly from supported sites.
userscriptStatus.checkingHelp: Checking for the userscript in this browser.
userscriptStatus.missingHelp: Make sure the script is enabled and up to date. In Chrome, also turn on Allow User Scripts (or Developer mode) in the Tampermonkey extension details and allow access to this Peach site, then refresh the page.
userscriptStatus.pairHelp: Generate a token, copy the pairing info, then paste and save it in the userscript settings.
userscriptStatus.readyHelp: Add videos to your Peach collection directly from supported sites.
userscriptStatus.title: Peach userscript

videoPreviews.decoderHelp: Used to generate covers, contact sheets, and timeline previews.
videoPreviews.generateHelp: Generates contact sheets and timeline previews for local videos.
videoPreviews.timelineHelp: Extracts frames at the selected interval, for videos on local disks only.
videoPreviews.title: Previews

wantSearch.giveUpHelp: Older releases pause after this many empty searches; resume them from the list.
wantSearch.intervalHelp: How often to search again for releases over 90 days old that weren't found.
wantSearch.title: Wants search

sourceBudget.requestsHelp: How much one scan and collection run asks of online sources; it stops at whichever limit comes first and the next run picks up the rest.

scrapingBrowser.modeHelp: With a window, switch to the scraping browser on the computer running Peach to verify manually. In headless mode, a failed check pauses the source.
scrapingBrowser.title: Collection browser

coverFallback.title: Covers
coverFallback.javdb: Use watermarked JavDB images when there is no other cover
coverFallback.javdbHelp: Off by default. Official and local covers always come first; an unwatermarked cover found later replaces it
